scope: Two fresh task-local native writers followed by article-only readers and complete-annotation readers. No matched baseline; no instruction-only improvement or general stability claim.
audience: Basic Python syntax, lists, arithmetic and loops; no prior knowledge of chosen algorithm or growing-structure costs.
questions: Derive each choice and the state meaning without external knowledge.
Reconstruct a new small legal input with before/after transitions and stopping condition.
Reconstruct correctness, branch boundaries and a failed plausible shortcut.

Reconstruct each stated main/alternative/changed-constraint cost, variables, operation frequencies, aggregate work, auxiliary/transient/output conventions. Quote actual explanatory bridges; flag recalled knowledge.
Map full runnable code to the transitions and actual Python behavior.
Challenge necessary/exclusive claims using a legal alternative mechanism; identify what is actually licensed.
Compare complete English/Traditional Chinese decision, exception, numerical/code and cost claims.
annotation_review: Every visible factual assertion including summaries, premises/checkpoints, Active sentence/cue/oracle; explicit supporting quotes and missing entailment; article-only Reader first gets no annotations.
failure_policy: Keep all first drafts, raw verdicts and revisions; at most three attempts for same problem, then reconsider premise.
capture_limit: Shared filesystem, policy restricted reads; independent native readback required; no claim of enforced sandbox isolation.
